name: Shingu (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Shingu city emblem in navy: a stylised device of two curled strokes above a lobed base.
history: Municipal flag of Shingu, a city in Wakayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in May 1948.

features.role: Shingu city emblem — a stylised device of two curled strokes above a lobed base
